parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: MemberIds
parameters.description:
The list of member account UIDs to associate with the project.
> You can call the ListMembersNotForProject operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
